lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head "no") No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did Steve do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well then why'd you say you don't know? Did Steve take the license plates off the car?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods "yes") Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And which way do you walk back?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The long way.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Which is which way?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We were, were like right to the pond and you keep on going and then you take a right and you go up the hill.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Whose got the key for the vehicle at that time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He did.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, where do you go when you get back up by his house, where do you go?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Back into his house.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what does he do with the key?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Puts it in his, his room.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where in his room does he put it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like under his dresser or somethin'.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did you see him put it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In his dresser drawer.
